title: Wall Street Giants Partner With Nvidia On $500 Billion AI Financing Deal - Slashdot
excerpt: Nvidia is working with Wall Street heavyweights on a potential $500 billion financing package for AI infrastructure (source paywalled; alternative source). content_html:
Nvidia is working with Wall Street heavyweights on a potential $500 billion financing package for AI infrastructure (source paywalled; alternative source). The consortium includes BlackRock's Global Infrastructure Partners, Brookfield Asset Management, Goldman Sachs and KKR. The Financial Times reports: The partnership underscores Nvidia's growing efforts to raise capital for itself and its clients to continue assembling the chips, power production and data centres at the heart of the AI boom. The $5.25 trillion company has positioned itself at the centre of the AI boom, providing chips, infrastructure and software to a wide array of partners developing the technology. Nvidia's graphics processing units, or GPUs, underpin most of the leading US AI models available today.

[...] The biggest cloud-computing companies, including Meta, Oracle, Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon, have dramatically increased their spending on AI infrastructure as they look to win the race to dominate the emerging technology. Morgan Stanley projects so-called hyperscalers will spend $3.5 trillion between 2026 and 2028. That need for capital has forced technology groups to tap every source of cash they can find, including public equity, investment-grade and high-yield bonds, securitized debt, private credit and project finance markets.

"[The] sheer size of the AI infrastructure build-out is unprecedented," Jim Zelter, president of Apollo, said on an earnings call earlier this month. "More than $8 trillion of capital is expected to be invested, a staggering sum. We see an enormous opportunity for private capital to finance a portion of this along with public capital."

content_html_zh: Nvidia 正在与华尔街重量级公司合作，为人工智能基础设施提供 5000 亿美元的潜在融资方案（来源付费；替代来源）。 该财团包括贝莱德全球基础设施合作伙伴、布鲁克菲尔德资产管理公司、高盛和 KKR。 英国《金融时报》报道称：此次合作凸显了英伟达不断努力为其自身及其客户筹集资金，以继续组装处于人工智能热潮核心的芯片、电力生产和数据中心。 这家市值 5.25 万亿美元的公司将自己定位在人工智能繁荣的中心，为开发该技术的众多合作伙伴提供芯片、基础设施和软件。 Nvidia 的图形处理单元（GPU）支撑着当今美国大多数领先的人工智能模型。 [...] 最大的云计算公司，包括 Meta、甲骨文、微软、Alphabet 和亚马逊，都大幅增加了在人工智能基础设施上的支出，因为他们希望赢得主导新兴技术的竞争。 摩根士丹利预计，2026 年至 2028 年间，所谓的超大规模企业将花费 3.5 万亿美元。 对资本的需求迫使科技集团利用他们能找到的一切现金来源，包括公共股权、投资级和高收益债券、证券化债务、私人信贷和项目融资市场。 “人工智能基础设施建设的规模是前所未有的，”阿波罗总裁吉姆·泽尔特在本月早些时候的财报电话会议上表示。 “预计将投入超过 8 万亿美元的资金，这是一个惊人的数字。 我们看到私人资本与公共资本一起为其中一部分提供资金的巨大机会。”
